services.customTitle: Something that isn’t a five-page site?

about.title: About
about.lead: Flowstate is Brandon Leroux. I rebuild websites and I make new ones.
about.body: Most of the work is restaurants, diners, trades, clinics — places with a phone number and a live site that no longer matches the room. I read what they actually print. I don’t invent hours, dollar prices, or a booking tool they don’t have. English-first when that’s their site. French when they need it.
